fact: Birth registration services in Liberia had been expanded to 22 hospitals (59 per cent of all hospitals), one health centre and five health districts, which were provided with computers or laptops and printers, while death registration was offered only at the central level in Monrovia.
title: Strengthening linkages between civil registration and the health sector for better health and improved civil registration systems: the cases of Uganda and Liberia (CRMC5/2019/14)
publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa, Fifth Conference of African Ministers Responsible for Civil Registration, Lusaka
